note: Every datum of Q0 is a field of the structure with the same type: finite-dimensional complex normed F_d, linear maps to the labels, projection from tokens to the sigma type, compact metric Borel phase space with a measure and a selected point, tables indexed by Option Character, continuation, finite channel sets, coefficients over finite index types and a degree-4 element. No axioms are imposed here, as in [M].

structure WightmanTheory (H : HilbertSpace) (Labels : FieldLabels) where
  fields : FieldSystem H Labels
  adjointLabel : Labels.carrier →ₛₗ[starRingEnd ℂ] Labels.carrier
  translations : TranslationAction H
  energyMomentum : EnergyMomentumMeasure H
  poincare : PoincareAction H Labels
  translationCompatibility (x : Spacetime) :
    poincare.onStates (poincare.pureTranslation x) = translations.operator x
